newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium retreats in line with dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium retreats in line with dollar.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed mostly lower in thin trade as the dollar retreated against the yen, traders said on Friday.

TOCOM aluminium prices ranged from 0.7 yen per kg higher to 3.1 yen weaker, with the benchmark April 1998 contract down 1.2 yen at 209.0 yen. The day's estimated trade volume was 3,376 lots, down slightly from 3,990 on Thursday.
"The market has no direction," said one trader, adding that prices failed to continue Thursday's climb and have been stuck within the same trading range since the contract's launch last month.
